preCall.headline: Video Conference Platform
preCall.subheadline: To join the meeting, please use the personal link sent to you.

linkRequired.title: Meeting Link Required
linkRequired.body: This page cannot be accessed directly. Please use the meeting link sent to you to join.

secureJoin.title: Secure Join
secureJoin.body: All meetings are encrypted and conducted securely. Only invited participants can join the meeting.

privacy.title: Privacy and Security
privacy.body: Your meetings are protected with end-to-end encryption. Your data is safe.

preCall.footer: Don't have a meeting link? Please contact the meeting organizer.

permission.title: Do you want others in the meeting to see and hear you?
permission.subtitle: You can turn your microphone and camera off any time during the meeting.

error.previouslyDenied: Permissions are denied. Please enable microphone and camera permissions in your browser settings.
error.unsupported: Your browser does not support access to media devices.
error.noDevice: Camera or microphone not found. You can continue without a device.
error.notAllowed: Permission not granted. Please grant microphone and camera permission in your browser settings.
error.inUse: Camera or microphone may be used by another application. Please close other applications and try again.
error.overconstrained: Device requirements cannot be satisfied. Please try a different camera or microphone.
error.generic: Permission could not be obtained: {{detail}}. Please grant microphone and camera permission in your browser settings.

settings.title: Device Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your audio and video devices
settings.speaker: Speaker
settings.backgroundEffectsUnsupported: Background effects are not supported in this browser

welcome.title: Join Conference
welcome.subtitle: Enter your name and check your camera before joining the call.

error.cameraOrMicDenied: Camera or microphone access was denied.

error.title: Connection Error
error.connectFailed: Failed to connect to the room. Please try again.
error.help: If the problem persists, please refresh the page or try again later.

screenShareError.notAllowed: Screen-sharing permission was denied. Please grant permission in your browser settings.
screenShareError.inUse: Could not start screen sharing. The screen may be in use by another application.
screenShareError.notSupported: Your browser does not support screen sharing.
